description: Six standardized scientific knowledge graph query templates supporting multi-paper evidence verification, disambiguation, and uncertainty reporting.

templates.name_zh: 单跳事实与直接证据查询
templates.description: Retrieve direct 1-hop relations involving a target entity (method, material, metric, or finding) along with conditions, epistemic status, and exact source_id + locator + verbatim quote.

example.query_text: What quantitative effect does catalyst A have on CO2 conversion under the reported experimental conditions?

templates.name_zh: 多跳路径与机制链路查询
templates.description: Traverse 2-to-3 hop paths from a material/method through intermediate mechanisms, datasets, or conditions to target outcomes while preserving per-hop paper scope.

example.query_text: Trace how Method M evaluated on Dataset D affects Metric P and under what Experimental_Condition.

templates.name_zh: 跨文献方法/结果对比查询
templates.description: Compare findings, metrics, or methods between primary and secondary papers WITHOUT collapsing distinct experimental conditions, samples, or numerical results into one conclusion.

example.query_text: Compare the catalysts and performance metrics reported in primary vs secondary papers without merging distinct experimental regimes.

templates.name_en: Conflict Detection & Entity Disambiguation Audit Query
templates.name_zh: 冲突关系与实体消歧核查查询
templates.description: Surface contradicting/non-replicated claims as well as homonym/generic-term non-merge decisions (e.g., why two 'control group' or 'baseline' mentions were kept separate).

example.query_text: Which candidate concepts across the two papers were kept separate rather than merged, and are there any contradicting findings?

templates.description: Given a node_id or edge_id, trace back every supporting independent paper source_id, paragraph_id/anchor_id, section_role, epistemic_status, and verbatim quote (excluding verification twin double-counting).

example.query_text: Trace the exact source_id, paragraph_id, and verbatim quote backing edge E-001.

templates.name_zh: 未报告项与无法确定关系边界查询
templates.description: Check whether a hypothesized relation, cross-paper equivalence, missing metadata field, or figure/supplement-dependent value can be answered from the provided text, returning 'undetermined' when ungrounded.

example.query_text: Does the secondary paper report the raw clinical patient-level table or PDF page numbers, and can its baseline be equated to the primary paper's baseline?
